articles.title: Meet Bolt, the Cutest Dog at the Airport (and He Works There!)
articles.summary: A German shorthaired pointer named Bolt just won the TSA's Cutest Canine Contest for 2026. He works at Dallas Fort Worth airport, sniffing for explosives. He's three years old and loves his job!

articles.title: A New Space Telescope Will See 100 Times More Sky Than Hubble!
articles.summary: NASA's Roman Space Telescope launches in two days! It has a mirror the same size as Hubble's but can see 100 times more sky. It will help scientists study dark matter and dark energy.

articles.title: A Weird Space Object That's Not a Planet or a Moon
articles.summary: Astronomers found an object as big as Jupiter orbiting a brown dwarf, which orbits a star. It's the first known 'exosatellite'—a new kind of object that blurs the line between planet and moon.
